facts.text: All undergraduate students participate in the three-year Professional Development Seminar (PDS), a cohort-based curriculum running from first year through junior year that includes resume drafting and a mock interview with a guest employer.

sources.title: Professional Development Seminar | Career Prep at Nichols
sources.quote: The seminar follows a cohort model from the first year through junior year. Students grow together, learn from shared experiences and build the foundation they need to succeed in internships and early career roles.
